categories.label: Conceptual Misunderstanding
categories.description: Student's mental model of the underlying concept is wrong, not just misapplied.

subject_manifestations.physics: Believes force is required to sustain constant velocity
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Confuses oxidation state with formal charge
subject_manifestations.math: Treats a limit as a value the function must reach, not approach

categories.label: Procedural Error
categories.description: Concept is understood but the step-by-step execution breaks down.

subject_manifestations.physics: Correct free-body diagram, wrong integration of resulting ODE
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Correct mechanism identified, arrow-pushing sequence wrong
subject_manifestations.math: Correct setup, algebraic slip in simplification

categories.label: Visualization / Spatial Constraint
categories.description: Student cannot hold or manipulate the required spatial/geometric mental model.

subject_manifestations.physics: Misreads vector directions in 2D/3D force diagrams
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Misassigns R/S stereochemistry or ring conformations
subject_manifestations.math: Fails to visualize solids of revolution or 3D coordinate geometry

categories.label: Logical Fallacy
categories.description: Reasoning chain contains an invalid inference step, independent of content knowledge.

subject_manifestations.physics: Assumes symmetry that doesn't hold under given constraints
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Overgeneralizes a trend (e.g. periodic trend) outside its valid range
subject_manifestations.math: Affirms the consequent in a proof step

categories.label: Calculation Speed Deficit
categories.description: Method is correct but too slow under exam time pressure, forcing shortcuts that introduce errors.

subject_manifestations.physics: Correct approach abandoned mid-way due to time
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Stoichiometry correct but arithmetic rushed and wrong
subject_manifestations.math: Correct differentiation, slow simplification eats remaining time

categories.label: Conceptual Synthesis Failure
categories.description: Individual concepts are known but the student cannot combine them across topics.

subject_manifestations.physics: Knows kinematics and energy separately, fails to combine for a mixed problem
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Knows thermodynamics and equilibrium separately, fails on combined Le Chatelier + ΔG problems
subject_manifestations.math: Cannot combine coordinate geometry with calculus in one problem

categories.label: Careless / Attention Slip
categories.description: Isolated, non-recurring error not reflective of a systematic gap.

subject_manifestations.physics: Sign error unrelated to conceptual understanding
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Misreads a subscript in a formula
subject_manifestations.math: Copies a number incorrectly between steps

categories.label: Formula Misapplication
categories.description: Correct formula exists in memory but is applied outside its valid conditions.

subject_manifestations.physics: Uses constant-acceleration kinematics equations in a variable-acceleration problem
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Applies ideal gas law where real-gas correction is required
subject_manifestations.math: Uses a convergence test outside its applicability conditions

categories.label: Time-Pressure Collapse
categories.description: Performance degrades sharply under simulated exam time constraints vs. untimed conditions.

subject_manifestations.physics: Correct on practice, incorrect on timed mock for the same topic
subject_manifestations.chemistry: Reaction mechanism questions answered correctly untimed, rushed/wrong timed
subject_manifestations.math: Multi-step problems abandoned or guessed only under time pressure
